units: <cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Ecclesiastes 11:3">Targ. Koh. XI, 3</cite> <he>למִנְפַּל</he>; a. v. fr.—Imperat. <cite ref="Q00660"><he>פִּיל</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Isaiah 50:11">Targ. Is. L, 11</cite>.—Part. <cite ref="N01041"><he>נָפֵיל</he></cite>, part. pass. <cite ref="N01043"><he>נְפִיל</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Proverbs 11:5">Targ. Prov. XI, 5</cite> (ed. Wil. <cite ref="N01055"><he>נְפַל</he></cite>).
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Psalms 145:14">Targ. Ps. CXLV, 14</cite>; a. e.—
<cite ref="Chullin 51a:10">Ḥull. 51ᵃ</cite> <he>אי נְפוּל לארעא</he> if they were thrown down (violently).
<cite ref="Nedarim 65b:3">Ned. 65ᵇ</cite> <he>כל דמעני לאו עלי נפיל</he> not every one that becomes poor, falls on me (for support).
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 105a:7">B. Mets. 105ᵃ</cite> <he>בזרא דנ׳ נ׳</he> a seed (of weeds) once fallen, has fallen (cannot be destroyed by the plough).
<cite ref="Megillah 15b:21">Meg. 15ᵇ</cite> <he>נַפְלָה ליה מילתא בדעתיה</he> something (a suspicion) had entered his mind; a. fr.
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Psalms 78:28">Targ. Ps. LXXVIII, 28</cite>.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Exodus 21:22">Targ. Y. Ex. XXI, 22</cite>; a. fr.—
<cite ref="Chullin 42a:1">Ḥull. 42ᵃ</cite> top <he>אַפּוּלֵי אפיל</he> (read <cite ref="A02735"><he>אַפְּלָא</he></cite>) she may have miscarried.
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 109b:3">Snh. 109ᵇ</cite> <he>ומַפְּלָא ליה</he> and she miscarried through his fault; a. fr.
<cite ref="Moed Katan 2a:5">M. Kat. 2ᵃ</cite> <he>דאתי לאִינְּפוּלֵי</he> a caving in (of the ground through which the water makes a road) might occur; <cite ref="Moed Katan 2b">ib.ᵇ</cite>; a. e.
